text:
sam: seeing a steady WS reconnect spike from eu mobile clients after we flipped the ephemeral-resume flag on cost-eu. repeated reconnects and some duplicated messages.

tori: console shows route `cost-eu` reconnects ~1.9% and token usage up ~4% for canary tenants.

sam: repro: long chat + cellular -> idle ~45s -> partial frame -> client reopens.

diego: gateway logs show parse_error on Resume-Hint v2, gateway drops resume -> new session created. snippet: 
[gw] parse_error: unsupported_resume_version=2 -> drop_resume

lin: we never released v2 to SDKs. control plane rolled resume_policy=EPHEMERAL and started emitting v2 hints. older gateways + SDKs treat unknown as fatal.

tori: mitigation options: 1) revert control-plane resume_policy (fast) 2) push gateway shim to accept unknown fields (30m). revert now?

diego: reverting now. also starting gateway compatibility patch to fallback to v1 semantics.

billing-bot: billing shows short blip in session_start + dedupe task recommended: suppress meter if new session within 2s with same trace.

console-bot: incident INC-8250 created. paging oncall.

sam: bump resume_hint parse_error sampling to 5% and add dashboard tile for resume_success by route.

tori: done. will add temporary warning in rollout UI for protocol-changing toggles.

lin: follow-ups: compatibility gate for proto changes, CI compatibility matrix, tag session_open with resume_protocol_version and routing_policy_hash.

diego: will own gateway shim + canary test.

sam: will own postmortem and UX guard.

billing-bot: will file BL-333 for billing dedupe mitigation.

sre-bot: incident INC-8250 status -> monitoring.

tori: reconnects back to baseline after revert. closing once gateway patch in canary and billing confirms credits if needed.
